script.base: DAL @ HOU, Dallas Cowboys at Houston Texans. Spread and total were not saved, so this is a form-only script, not a book read of who leads. The Cowboys (DAL) have been pass-leaning: CeeDee Lamb 26 targets, 309 yards, 311 air yards and George Pickens 25 targets, 150 yards, 267 air yards, and Dak Prescott is 0.45 EPA per dropback when not blitzed (n=44) versus 0.05 when blitzed. The Texans (HOU) blitz only 23%, so the base case is Prescott working the Texans middle (10.11 YPA on 27 attempts) and right (9.48 on 42), not the Texans left wall at 3.89. Houston run game is stuck (David Montgomery 37 carries, 103 yards, 2.78 YPC; Woody Marks 22/65, 2.95 YPC), so C.J. Stroud's identity is Dalton Schultz (25 targets, 205 yards). Expect a pass-leaning DAL-HOU game.
script.flip1: HOU blitzes well above 23%. DAL quarterback Prescott falls into the 0.05 EPA split, Cowboys air yards to Lamb and Pickens stop converting, and checkdowns rise — Javonte Williams already has 12 targets at -32 air yards.
script.flip2: DAL run defense (5.23 YPC allowed, 15 runs of 10+) gets gashed, HOU stays on the ground with Montgomery (37 carries) and Marks (22), Stroud dropbacks shrink, and Texans tight end Schultz targets die. Other clock-kill: the Cowboys lead and Williams (43 carries) runs it out.
